thread:
Nina P: Quick check 1 I accepted the orientation invite but my calendar shows it at 02:00 UTC, which would be middle of the night for me. The invite text says 9am PT though.
Diego M: Same here. I think Outlook / Exchange sometimes converts weirdly when the .ics includes both a Z timestamp and a TZID.
Nina P: Copied the .ics snippet if it helps:
```
BEGIN:VEVENT\nDTSTART:20260503T160000Z\nDTEND:20260503T170000Z\nTZID:America/Los_Angeles\nSUMMARY:New Hire Orientation - Redwood\nEND:VEVENT
```
Jia L: Yup that's the cause. DTSTART with trailing Z is absolute UTC but TZID says LA. Google Calendar tends to reconcile, Exchange picks the Z.
Rachael (People Ops): Thanks for catching this. We're supposed to schedule in Pacific time and not force UTC on the .ics. I'll ask the bot to regenerate invites without the Z suffix and add an APAC repeat. Sorry for the noise.
onboarding-bot: Regenerating orientation invitations with TZID-only timestamps, adding Friday APAC repeat, and will post recording + captions to onboarding wiki after session.
Diego M: Workaround: in Outlook open the event > Meeting > Time Zones and switch the zone to (UTC-08:00) Pacific Time, then save. Or delete and re-accept when the updated invite arrives.
Nina P: I'm on CET so I'll probably watch the recording. Will that be available?
Rachael (People Ops): Yes we record all orientations. We'll upload the video, auto captions, and a short transcript to the onboarding wiki (https://internal.redwood.com/onboarding/orientation) within an hour after the session. We'll also include an edited summary.
Jia L: If folks in APAC want a live-friendly time, react with :wave: and we'll pick one next week.
Nina P: Deleted my event, will wait for the corrected invite. Thanks! :thumbsup:
onboarding-bot: Task complete  updated invites sent and APAC repeat added. Reminder: recording will be posted to onboarding wiki after session.
